title: Router-on-a-Stick Inter-VLAN Routing
summary: Configure a router-on-a-stick topology using IEEE 802.1Q trunking and Cisco IOS logical subinterfaces to route traffic between isolated departmental VLANs.
learning_objectives: Explain the concept and scalability constraints of a router-on-a-stick inter-VLAN routing design
Configure an 802.1Q trunk link on a Cisco Catalyst switch uplink to the router
Create and configure Cisco IOS logical subinterfaces for multiple VLANs
Configure 802.1Q encapsulation and default gateway IP addresses on subinterfaces
Verify inter-VLAN routing reachability using ping and traceroute commands

source.origin: Independently authored routing curriculum guide based on Cisco IOS XE configuration documentation and IEEE 802.1Q standards
